status: FROZEN 2026-10-25 by the user's decision (ECI v2.0 = V2-full recipe with the thin-part mask N2; the previous frozen spec of 2026-10-20 is configs/eci_v2/representation_2026-10-20_F0.json)
encoder: facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m @ ea8dc2863c51be0a264bab82070e3e8836b02d51, block 20 + final LayerNorm, bf16 + SDPA
resolution: native side (multiple of 16), never upsampled; tadpoles: 96 px animal-following crop -> 384 px
canonical: mice rot90 odour corner top right; frogs juveniles hflip mutant side right; others none
mask: N2 (thin-part): token kept iff >= 25% of its 16 x 16 patch are animal pixels of the mask2 cue (src/eci/v2/mask2.py: frozen per-domain pixel cue as core + hysteresis growth against the per-video median background) OR >= 16 appendage pixels (mask2.appendage, MIN_THIN_PX); frogs: growth restricted to the dish ROI (juveniles) / crop ROI (tadpoles)
training_data: one SAE per domain, 1 fps of every video of the domain (all experiments pooled, every frame of the 1 fps grid; mice / ants: the V2-full 'full1' store + the scored frames, scripts/eci/v2_diag/diag.py arm V2F_N2)
deploy: highest held-out FVE among the seeds (label-free)
frame_readout: max over kept tokens (theta* token codes), every 5 fps frame
continuous: centred mean over +-1 frame at 5 fps (0.6 s window) of the frame max = '<sae>_smooth'
probability: per-neuron 3-state zero-inflated log-normal HMM on the raw 5 fps frame max (src/eci/v2/hmm.py, K = 3), fitted label-free per domain on the calibration videos; P(on) = '<sae>_hmm', Viterbi on-state = '<sae>_hmmv'
video_summaries: mean P(on) (expected fraction of time on; PRIMARY NES outcome), bout rate and latency from the Viterbi on-state, mean of the continuous value (secondary)
